newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean feed millers seek 52,500 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean feed millers seek 52,500 tonnes of corn.

text.p: A South Korean buyers group, known as the Top Margin Committee, invited tenders on Tuesday to buy 52,500 tonnes of corn, traders said.
Traders said arrival was set for December 10 to the western port of Inchon.
Shipment was slated for November 11-30, if from the Pacific Northwest or for October 21-November 10, if from the U.S. Gulf.
The buyer had passed on the tenders last Thursday due to higher-than-expected prices, they said.
